GeneDef.label: fungal vampirism resurrection
GeneDef.description: Carriers host fungal symbionts in their blood that can infuse a corpse, rebuild degenerated tissue and bring it back to life. The fungus then rewrites the body's germline into the carrier's own, so the risen share the carrier's genes. This can only be done very rarely, and comes at a steep hemogen cost.

customEffectDescriptions.li: The risen pawn's germline genes and xenotype are replaced with the caster's. Their xenogenes are kept.
The caster's genes do not need to regrow afterwards.

GeneDef.label: sanguine spores
GeneDef.description: Carriers grow blood-red spores in their bloodstream and can exhale them in a cloud. Enemies who breathe the spores begin to bleed, and the cloud leaves a rot stink behind.
